svg.text: Change both the anatomical region and the time interval
Two illustrative presentations of the same input; cells are joint × time-block tokens, not measured results.
Leg rows shown; arm rows omitted.
Across advancing random draws, audit every eligible joint at every time position.
A changing mask alone does not guarantee that hips or ankles receive enough context.
Artificial masks select available inputs. Reference-valid training targets are tracked in a separate array.
